case.scientific_claim: Do closed-lid-seeded apo human HSP90alpha N-terminal-domain trajectories depart their initial conformation more often than open-lid-seeded trajectories, and do the observed paths support closed-to-open directional behavior?

evidence_items.construct_and_condition: Apo human HSP90alpha N-terminal domain; deposited coordinate payload contains ARG46 and ARG60. R60A_GS denotes structural seed lineage, not mutant simulation identity.
evidence_items.sample_composition: Twenty independently initialized trajectories for this seed family; exact author execution provenance beyond deposited methods UNKNOWN.
evidence_items.native_observable: Saved time-ordered coordinates for each trajectory; local source derivative contains 1021 frames of 213 Calpha atoms per run in nm.
evidence_items.estimand: Trajectory-level departure from initial lid geometry and directional structural path relative to source NMR anchors.
evidence_items.spatial_support: Author residues11-223; core Calpha40-97 and137-220; lid98-136. Reference mapping described separately.
evidence_items.unit_or_aggregation: Twenty trajectories per seed family; saved frames0-1020ns every1ns; existing author-analysis window20-1020ns. Frames within a trajectory are correlated.
